title: chara-resolve-service resolveCharaEquipment sends unbounded model lanes/glasses id; one lane >0xffff 400s the whole resolve and the Reader reports an outage
reason: core readModelLane/readGlassesId accept any finite >0 and floor (chara-parser.ts:498-513); api-worker lane() rejects >LANE_MAX 0xffff for the whole body with 400 (router.ts:42,63-75,133-146); client maps any !ok to CharaResolveUnavailableError (chara-resolve-service.ts:156-161) -> resolveState 'unavailable' (glamour-block.ts:370-371) -> 'Item names unavailable' note (en.json:1269) for every piece. Only hand-edited/corrupt files (game lanes are uint16), so LOW.

No new wrong result: any stainId that matches no dye (e.g. integer 200) already takes the designed '#<id>' fallback (glamour-block.ts:839,844; glamour-list-actions.ts:99); 3.5 just shows the file's raw value through the same honest path. Push is chara-parser.ts:474-476.

Decided and disclosed: PRIVACY.md:35-38 names this exact local-only fallback (nickname -> file name) for on-device saves; the community path never reads it (glamour-block.ts:1706-1708). The log lines are logger.info, which is dev-only (shared/logger.ts:152-155).

Disclosed behaviour on the player's own navigation: PRIVACY.md §Character files (lines 39-45) describes the resolve request; the Reader's card (PR #223) states it; payload is non-personal model integers; the candidate's own fix offers 'accept as disclosed'. Origin is MAIN (syncBlock->show->startResolve at 8ecb878f; #223 changed copy only).

title: glamour-twin-picker (role=dialog) and item-links-menu never register with ModalService, so global 1-9/Shift+T/L/S shortcuts fire while they hold focus
reason: Picker is role=dialog (line 98) appended to body; its document keydown handles only Escape (226-234) and list handler only arrows/Home/End, no ModalService.registerExternal (export sheet does, glamour-sheet.ts:428). keyboard-service.ts:155 only suppresses when hasOpenModals(); a radio is not text entry, so '2' navigates and Shift+T flips theme behind the open dialog. Cosmetic/inconsistent, nothing lost.

Matches the documented 'only the newest may publish / the one the player picked last' contract (chara-file-loader.ts:30-35): an oversize B (line 51) behaves exactly like a B that fails to parse — A is superseded by the player's own later pick, B's refusal is toasted, the prior session is untouched.

Claim is accurate (~2N+2 full read+JSON.parse plus one write per keystroke, no cache, no maxLength) but at a realistic store of a few KB that is microseconds per keystroke; only a self-inflicted MB-sized paste (bounded by the localStorage quota) is slow. Expected gain none at realistic sizes.

title: glamour-block DYEABLE_SLOTS duplicates core chara-gposers private DYEABLE with a 'change both' comment
reason: Identical 7-slot sets at glamour-block.ts:147-155 and chara-gposers.ts:84-92, linked only by a comment (lines 144-145). Drift risk is in membership only, which is a stable game fact; the block deliberately still draws accessory dyes via its non-dyeable branch (819-822) while the export drops them, so the sets' users already diverge on purpose.

title: swatch-tool setConfig applies ConfigController's full swatch config (default hairColors/SeekerOfTheSun/Female) over tool-local eyeColors/Midlander/Male state
reason: Every hop is traced. The sidebar writes a partial, the controller merges it into stored or default values and broadcasts the whole object, and swatch setConfig treats colorSheet/race/gender as authoritative. Nothing ever writes the tool's colorSheet into the controller.

title: swatch-tool setConfig needsReload branch nulls selectedColor but leaves matchedDyes, result cards, SEND TO ids and an enabled share button
reason: The reload path clears only selectedColor. matchedDyes, the rendered cards, the handoff ids and the share-button state survive the palette change.

title: swatch-tool pickCharaSlot sets a slot selectionContext but keeps the earlier grid selectedColor/matchedDyes, so CLOSEST DYES, share and SEND TO describe the old cell
reason: The slot pick and the grid pick write different state. The UI then mixes the two: the card describes the slot while the dye list and handoffs describe cell A.

title: swatch-tool findMatchingDyes filters after a top-(maxResults*3) request, so strong dye filters return fewer than maxResults; closestDyeTo ignores filters
reason: Same filter-after-limit shape as the fixed /v1/match/within-distance bug. It is reachable with the shipped vendor/craft exclusion filters.

title: gradient-tool calculateInterpolation seeds usedDyeIds with endpoints only, so a free step before a pinned step can match the pinned dye undeduplicated
reason: The asymmetry is unconditional in the code. Whether the duplicate shows depends on dye geometry, but a step interpolating toward a pinned anchor is the likely case.

title: gradient/swatch loadFromShareUrl applies share settings to tool-local state only; the next ConfigController notification reverts them
reason: The share-link state never reaches the controller. Any later broadcast carries the controller's stale values, and setConfig applies them.

title: swatch-tool registers its window resize listener with this.on in onMount; BaseComponent.update() unbinds it on a language switch and never re-adds it
reason: The listener lives in the listeners map that update() clears. Nothing re-registers it, and nothing remounts the tool on a language or viewport change.

title: swatch/gradient renderLeftPanel rebuilds CollapsiblePanel/MarketBoard/DyeSelector on every update() into the element renderRightPanel clears, without destroying the previous instances
reason: Each update() orphans subscribed child components. They keep re-rendering and relaying service events into live tool callbacks. Bounded by language switches, so LOW.

title: swatch-tool.ts updateHandoffRow: SEND TO does a full reload with window.location.assign, so the in-memory .chara session is dropped
reason: swatch-tool.ts:2341 binds each SEND TO chip to window.location.assign(target.url), which is a full document load. chara-session-service.ts:10-11 says the session is kept in memory only by design, so a reload clears it. The loaded character is lost on every SEND TO click.

title: gradient-tool.ts result-card slot picker (Set as End/Start) has no same-dye guard, and endpoint rows render cards
reason: calculateInterpolation pushes the start and end dyes as the endpoint rows' matchedDye. renderIntermediateMatches renders a card for every row with showSlotPicker=true, and compact cards still show actions. add-mixer-slot-2 then sets selectedDyes[1]=startDye with none of selectDye's sameDyeWarning or swap guard. The transform-gradient half of the claim cannot be reached: cards only exist when both endpoints are set, so that path always takes slotsFull.

title: gradient-tool.ts loadSelectedDyes drops persisted custom-colour endpoints and moves the remaining dye into the Start slot
reason: saveSelectedDyes (301-304) stores d.id, which is the negative synthetic id from makeCustomDye. loadSelectedDyes (266-269) maps those ids through getDyeById, which returns null for them (dyesByIdMap miss), and then filters the nulls out. The array is positional (startDye = selectedDyes[0]), so the surviving end dye moves into Start. Nothing syncs the URL, so a plain reload reads from storage.

title: swatch-tool.ts / gradient-tool.ts copy-hex clipboard .then without .catch (dead path)
reason: The code is unreachable: 'copy-hex' is one of the six legacy ContextAction members that result-card.ts never emits. DEAD-003 removes swatch's whole handleContextAction (2418-2428) and gradient's legacy cases (2088-2109), including both clipboard calls.

title: swatch-tool.test.ts and gradient-tool.test.ts: the filter-application, reverse-rematch and displayOptions-merge tests assert only not.toThrow()
reason: Each named test asserts only not.toThrow(). The dyeFilters test (723-733) checks no match output, the 're-runs the reverse match' test (790-796) checks no reverseMatchedSwatches after the sheet change, and the displayOptions merge test (715-721) checks no merged state. Gradient's it.each (948-956) and the stepCount test (973) are the same, apart from one storage write. Line 553 asserts only leftPanel.children > 0.

title: swatch-tool.ts (3146 lines) and gradient-tool.ts (2755 lines): duplicated desktop/mobile selector code already drifts (mobile steps skip pinnedSteps.clear), a dead left panel and drawer, and a mojibake literal at gradient-tool.ts:825
reason: The drift is real. The desktop steps slider (gradient-tool.ts:895-906) calls pinnedSteps.clear(), while the mobile one (2428-2439) does not. V4 passes drawerContent: null and leftPanel === rightPanel, and renderRightPanel clears that element (973), so the mobile and left-panel copies are built and then discarded. The mojibake bullet at 825 is on main. No dead-code entry covers the panel or drawer removal.

title: harmony-tool.ts LanguageService.subscribe -> update() rebuilds an empty harmonyGridContainer and never regenerates harmonies
reason: update() runs renderContent and renderRightPanel (1048-1137), which build a fresh empty grid. HarmonyTool has no onUpdate, and the rebuilt DyeSelector's setSelectedDyes (dye-selector.ts:486) does not emit selection-changed, so nothing calls generateHarmonies. Graded MEDIUM, not HIGH: a language switch is infrequent and the next interaction restores the results.

title: mixer-tool.ts language update() recreates resultsSection with display:none; matches, Export and Share vanish
reason: renderRightPanel (1372+) creates resultsSection with 'display: none' and an empty grid. Nothing afterwards calls showEmptyState(false) or renderResultsGrid (no onUpdate in mixer-tool), so with both slots filled the results are hidden. MEDIUM: an infrequent action, fixed by the next interaction.

title: mixer-tool/budget-tool never seed dyeFiltersConfig from persisted config at mount
reason: config-sidebar.ts:893-908 persists dyeFilters into the mixer and budget configs. ConfigController.subscribe (config-controller.ts:346-362) never replays, and neither the Mixer constructor (188-205) nor Budget's constructor or onMount reads dyeFilters, so both start from DEFAULT_DYE_FILTERS. MEDIUM: filters are opt-in.

title: budget-tool.ts ignores persisted ConfigController displayOptions at mount; showHue/Stain/Spectrum always reset to true
reason: The constructor reads only the local v3_budget_show_* keys (221-228). The sidebar broadcast (config-sidebar.ts:862-873) writes only the ConfigController budget config, and subscribe does not replay, so the comment at 173 ('ConfigController replays them') is false. LOW: only target-card display rows are wrong (cosmetic).

title: budget-tool.ts findAlternatives has no run guard; a superseded run overwrites this.rows after a newer run
reason: The target and threshold captured before await fetchPrices are reused after it. A superseded fetch returns an empty Map (market-board-service.ts:359-365), but the continuation still writes this.rows (582-598) and renders. Reordering needs two overlapping uncached batches with different keys, such as the mount fetch plus an early slider tick or selectDye. After the first fetch the consolidated IDs come from cache. Edge path, hence MEDIUM.

title: budget-tool.ts in-page match-line slider writes only local storage; next full budget-config broadcast resets it to ConfigController maxDeltaE
reason: The live slider (rendered from renderMain:737; handler 991-998) never updates ConfigController. setConfig (config-controller.ts:306-334) notifies the full merged config, so a later displayOptions, matchingMethod or dyeFilters write carries maxDeltaE 8. clampMatchLine(8) differs from 14, so the match line is reset, persisted and refetched, and the slider thumb is left at 14.

title: budget-tool.ts saveSwapRecord breaks 216-gil ties by database order, not by ΔE
reason: priceOf gives every tier-A row gil = CONSOLIDATED_DYES.A.price (216). The reduce uses strict < over this.rows, which is in getAllDyes order (582-598, unsorted), so the first Standard dye in range is saved, not the closest. Save swap is live (renderTargetOverview:1191). MEDIUM: an edge feature.

title: result-card setAsBudgetTarget is overridden by a preserved ?dye= that budget-tool handleDeepLink applies
reason: setAsBudgetTarget (result-card.ts:1216-1220) stores v3_budget_target and calls navigateTo('budget') with no params. navigateTo copies PRESERVED_PARAMS including dye (router-service.ts:105, 186-189), and Harmony never clears its URL. Budget's onMount handleDeepLink (428-435) then resolves the stale dye and overwrites the target. DEAD-003 removes only the legacy 'budget' cases, not inspect-budget.

title: harmony-tool.ts handleDeepLink: a stale preserved ?dye= overrides the user's later base-dye pick
reason: Harmony saves a new pick to storage only (harmony-tool.ts:959-963, 1985-1990) and never rewrites the URL. router-service.ts:105/188 PRESERVED_PARAMS carries the old dye= across every tool switch, and v4-layout.ts:559/600 remounts Harmony. onMount (harmony-tool.ts:328) then hands that dye to handleDeepLink (:577-606), which replaces and persists the restored dye. Any handoff or 'Inspect in Harmony' leaves dye= in the URL for the rest of the session. Budget's handleDeepLink reads the same param too (context only).

title: budget-tool.ts handleDeepLink: ?maxDelta= changes matchLine after the slider and label were rendered
reason: init renders the slider at :984 and the label at :957 from the stored matchLine. onMount then calls handleDeepLink (:297), which sets matchLine at :445 without touching matchLineValueDisplay, the slider value or renderMain. setConfig (:335-340) does update both labels. findAlternatives (:546-614) never re-renders the match-line section, so the ledger filters at the link's value while the slider shows the stored one. Budget share links always carry maxDelta (:1246). Only ciede2000 is affected; other methods disable the slider.

title: harmony-tool.ts renderRightPanel: each render adds a new matchMedia listener; destroy removes only the last
reason: renderRightPanel runs on every update() (renderContent :265). Each run builds a new MediaQueryList and adds onRailBreakpoint, and destroy (:435) removes it from the latest list only. Language changes (:312) and every deep-link mount with dye (handleDeepLink's update() at :601) leave earlier lists firing renderTypeRail, also after the tool is destroyed. The effect is a latent leak with redundant DOM work.

title: budget-tool.ts onMount: forces and persists the global market.showPrices=true and never restores it
reason: setShowPrices(true) goes to ConfigController.setConfig('market', {showPrices}) (market-board-service.ts:251-257), which persists to localStorage. destroy (:303-311) never restores the old value, so a user who turned prices off has them on, and fetching, in Harmony/Mixer/Comparison after one Budget visit. This is distinct from webapp-v4-shell-01, which covers the sidebar not re-reading the value; this covers the persisted write.

title: budget-tool.ts / mixer-tool.ts: theme-dependent inline colours are not refreshed on a theme change
reason: tierRamp (:504), accent (:517), renderVerdict (:1260), the ledger (:1431) and mixer spreadTone (mixer-tool.ts:1150) read ThemeService.isDarkMode() once, at render, into inline hex styles. The only ThemeService.subscribe callers are theme-modal.ts:60 and v4-app-header.ts:82, so neither tool re-renders on a theme switch. The effect is cosmetic until the next re-render.

title: mixer-tool.ts renderMixingField: a cell with no eligible match prints ΔE 0.0
reason: `findMatchingDyesEngine(...)[0]?.distance ?? 0` makes an empty pool render as 0.0, which reads as an exact match. The pool can be emptied from the sidebar filters: the 125 dyes are 85 Dye Vendor + 9 Firmament + 20 Coffers + 11 Cosmic, so excludeVendorDyes + excludeCraftDyes + excludeCosmic exclude all of them.

title: mixer-tool.ts loadSelectedDyes: a legacy third slot is restored, giving an equal-weight 3-way blend
reason: loadSelectedDyes restores slot 2 (:222) and blends every non-null slot, so blendColorsInternal takes the equal-weight blendColors path, ignores mixRatio, and the field is suppressed (:1164). loadFromShareUrl (:676-717) overwrites only slots 0 and 1, so a recipient's stale slot 2 turns a shared pair into a 3-way blend that ignores ratio. No storage migration trims the key; only pre-42f0579f (2026-08-08) storage has the slot. It clears on the first selector pick (:1038) or selectDye (:803).

title: mixer-tool.ts field-cell click renders the field twice; harmony-tool.ts market change runs a superseded price pass
reason: Confirmed only in part. The mixer cell handler (mixer-tool.ts:1305-1312) calls updateCraftingUI, which always runs renderMixingField (:1827), then calls renderMixingField again: 30 blends and 30 full-pool ΔE scans are done twice. The Harmony 'two requests' claim is wrong at the network level: core getPricesForDataCenter merges identical in-flight batches (APIService.ts:986-1003, OPT-001). Only one superseded MarketBoardService pass and an extra strip/card update remain.

title: comparison-tool.ts renderContent: a language switch rebuilds the results empty and leaks the previous left-panel components
reason: update() (base-component.ts:148-163) re-runs renderContent only. renderRightPanel (842-958) rebuilds every section display:none with the empty state visible, and nothing calls updateResults, so 2-4 selected dyes show 'select dyes' with Export/Share hidden. The old DyeSelector, MarketBoard and panels are never destroyed. Narrowed: the 'drops the 3 dyes' consequence is false. In V4 leftPanel===rightPanel (v4-layout.ts:636-640), so the new selector is detached and never fires selection-changed, and addDye pushes onto the intact this.selectedDyes.

title: accessibility-tool.ts renderContent: a language switch leaves the lens grid, pair readout and cards hidden, and drops custom colours
reason: updateResults runs only from onMount (277-285), not from update(). renderRightPanel (726-760+) rebuilds the empty state visible and the selected, lens and pair sections display:none. renderDyeSelector's storage restore (565-576) overwrites selectedDyes with the dyes it can resolve, so custom colours (negative ids, not in getAllDyes) are lost from a mixed selection.

title: comparison-tool.ts buildSevenReadouts: the ΔE2000 tier skips tierFor's 0->1 bump, so it contradicts the verdict when matchThreshold < 5
reason: tierFor (1190-1197) returns 0 only below matchThreshold and otherwise bumps a band tier of 0 to 1. The readout loop (1914-1915) takes classifyBandTier and forces 0 below the threshold, but never bumps. The ciede2000 match cuts are [5,10,20] (band-vocabulary.ts:94), and the sidebar slider allows 1-15 (config-sidebar.ts:1257-1260).

The dye-grid code reads as described, but no production path puts a DyeGrid on screen. Every tool is constructed only in v4-layout.ts:600-703 with leftPanel===rightPanel===mainPanel and drawerContent:null; renderRightPanel clears that container after renderLeftPanel builds the DyeSelector (mixer-tool.ts:584-587 documents this), so a user can never Tab to a dye button. Not in the dead-code catalog, so REJECTED rather than SUPERSEDED.

Both checkbox handlers are unreachable in production. renderVisionToggles (668, called from renderLeftPanel:517) renders into mainPanel, and renderRightPanel:728 then clears it. renderDrawerVisionToggles (1765) runs only when drawerContent is set, and V4 passes null (v4-layout.ts:624-628). The live toggle path is setConfig, which already reconciles (BUG-096).

title: comparison/accessibility getShareParams: Share stays enabled for an all-custom-colour selection that yields dyes:[]
reason: Confirmed for an all-custom selection only. disabled is computed as selectedDyes.length===0 (2451-2455) while the params filter out stainID-null entries. Comparison: validateShareParams (share-service.ts:668-672) rejects, and the button shows 'Invalid share params: Missing required parameter: dyes'. Accessibility (1927-1946): there is no validation case, so a link that restores no dyes is copied. A mixed selection sharing fewer dyes is documented by design (the selectCustomColor docstrings say custom colours never enter share URLs).

title: extractor-tool.ts fetchPricesForRoll: the catch, parseMarketError and lastMarketError are unreachable because every layer below swallows fetch failures
reason: MarketBoardService.fetchPricesForDyes catches everything and returns an empty Map (market-board-service.ts:399-410), so the extractor's catch never runs and marketError is never set. Below it, core APIService.fetchBatchPriceData (APIService.ts:654-674) also turns HTTP and network failures into an empty Map, so a proxy outage reports lastFetchOutcome 'ok'. The suggested lastFetchOutcome fix would therefore not fire. Tests pass only because they mock the service to throw, which cannot happen in production.

title: comparison-tool.ts ensureActivePair: the index-based pair survives a removal and swaps out the surviving member
reason: Corrected repro. The original (remove a bench dye) is unreachable in V4: bench chips only swap (1534-1538), and the left-panel remove buttons are detached. Duel cards do call removeDye (1493), and removeDye (2010-2018) never resets activePair, so stored indices that are still in range point at different dyes.

title: dye-selector.ts handleGlobalKeydown: activeElement guard is blind inside the shell's shadow root, so '/' is swallowed in tool inputs
reason: Tools mount inside V4LayoutShell's shadow root (v4-layout.ts:473-485 getContentContainer), so document.activeElement is the <v4-layout-shell> host and dye-selector.ts:290 never sees INPUT. A '/' typed into any shadow-side field, including the DyeSelector's own search box, is preventDefaulted. keyboard-service.ts:111-133 already documents and fixes this exact retargeting.

title: dye-selector.ts updateFavoritesPanel hardcodes the 8-column grid and overrides compactMode's 3-column favourites layout at mount
reason: It is worse than claimed. onMount (dye-selector.ts:464-470) calls updateFavoriteDyes right away, and subscribeFavorites fires immediately too (collection-service.ts:1020-1026). So updateFavoritesPanel (:680) swaps in the 8-col grid at mount, and the compact grid-cols-3 (:588-590) is never visible once any favourite exists. compactMode:true + showFavorites:true are used by comparison/accessibility/gradient/harmony/mixer.

title: image-zoom-controller.ts touch handlers: a second finger does not cancel the drag, so a two-finger gesture commits a colour sample on lift
reason: touchstart (image-zoom-controller.ts:710-719) returns on touches.length!==1 and leaves isDragging=true from the first finger. touchmove bails on 2 touches, then the first lifted finger's touchend (:744-760) passes the isDragging guard and calls sampleColorAtArea at that point. The card's touch-action:none (extractor-tool.ts:874) means a pinch attempt has no browser effect, only an unintended sample.

title: image-zoom-controller.ts Ctrl-drag pan ignores the centring margin, so a fitted image jumps on the first pan move
reason: autoFit leads to fitToWidth/fitToScreen, which call resetPan and updateZoom(...,true), so isCentered=true and margin = centring + panOffset (:359-365). The Ctrl-drag mousemove (:600-610) writes margin = panOffset+dx and drops the centring term. On a fitted image with a non-zero centring margin, the first move jumps by that margin; mouseup (:655-664) then sets isCentered=false, so the jump persists.

title: comparison-tool.ts renders the market price row from its own showMarketPrices flag, while the service's showPrices (default off) blocks fetching
reason: Defaults: comparison displayOptions.showPrice=true (tool-config-types.ts:356/:459, comparison-tool.ts:115) but market.showPrices=false (:414). fetchPricesForDyes filters on shouldFetchPrice, which returns false when !showPrices (market-board-service.ts:297, :321), so the cards render 'Market · Crystal' with '—' forever (result-card.ts:1046, :1684-1691). Harmony, gradient, mixer and swatch share the ungated pattern; only the extractor ANDs it (extractor-tool.ts:1989).

title: accessibility-tool.test.ts: typeof/not.toThrow tests leave the language rebuild (update keeps results) and the checkbox lens reconcile unpinned
reason: accessibility-tool.test.ts:438-445 and :459-478 assert only typeof==='function', and :445-451, :480-496 and :533-548 assert only not.toThrow. The file never calls update(), never changes language and never toggles the in-tool vision checkbox. e2e/accessibility-checker.spec.ts only checks that a switch flips its checked state. Results-survive-update and active-lens reconcile are pinned nowhere.

title: config-sidebar.ts connectedCallback: local copies of 9 config keys never refresh after an external ConfigController write
reason: connectedCallback (669-701) subscribes only to swatch and harmony. The shell is created once (v4-layout.ts:169) and only gets active-tool updates (:319). budget-tool.ts:292 setShowPrices(true) writes market.showPrices (market-board-service.ts:251-256). mixer-tool.ts:692 writes mixer.mixingMode. resetAllConfigs notifies every key (config-controller.ts:369-385), but 'settings-reset' has no listener. Worse: after a reset, toggling any display option sends the stale pre-reset allOptions back to global (config-sidebar.ts:857, display-options-v4.ts:333).

title: v4-layout-shell.ts:141 100vh host on mobile
reason: The 'unreachable' claim is not supported. html/body carry no overflow lock (globals.css:169-172 sets only overflow-x; index.html has an unstyled #app), so a 100vh document taller than the toolbar-visible viewport still scrolls. Default scroll chaining from the inner scroller then hides the toolbar. The candidate admits it was never tried on a device.

title: dye-palette-drawer.ts renderSwatch: swatch is a click-only div, so keyboard users cannot pick a dye from the app-wide picker
reason: The .swatch div (1194-1199) has @click only: no role, no tabindex, no keydown. A grep for keydown|tabindex|role= in the file finds none. The star is opacity:0 and visible only under .swatch:hover (492, 505-508), with no focus or hover:none rule. The Custom colour (1125) and Favourites (1238) headers are click-only divs. The custom-hex box picks a colour, not a dye.

title: dye-palette-drawer.ts filterByType: Metallic chip matches English name (14) instead of the gloss set isMetallic (16)
reason: Line 783 filters on name.includes('metallic'), and dyes.json has 14 such names. METALLIC_STAIN_IDS (dye-vocabulary.ts:63-70, decided 2026-07-30) holds 16 IDs, including 92 Gunmetal Black and 93 Pearl White. DyeDatabase.ts:257-260 derives isMetallic from that set, and DyeFilter.ts:38 already uses it.

title: v4-layout-shell.ts re-emits composed child events without stopPropagation, so v4-layout handlers run twice
reason: emit() is bubbles+composed (base-lit-component.ts:110-117). These shell handlers re-emit without stopping the original: config-change (863), clear-all-dyes (919), theme/changelog/about/language (936-962) and advanced (997). handleDyeSelected (911) does stop it. The v4-layout listeners on the host therefore fire twice. This is latent only: the modal shows are guarded (e.g. advanced-options-panel.ts:376) and tool setConfig is change-gated (budget-tool.ts:324+).

title: dye-palette-drawer.ts handleRandomDye ignores filters
reason: This is the documented intent: the docblock at 858-859 says 'Select a random dye from all available dyes'. The claimed wrong state is supported anyway. Budget handles consolidated targets through the tier logic (budget-tool.ts:456-526, 1115), and a user reaches that state by re-enabling spectra. A product call, not a defect.

title: v4-layout-shell.ts static styles have no @media print: browser print is one clipped page including chrome
reason: The only @media print in src is v4-layout.css:17, which sets only the host background. Its comment (18-21) says chrome hiding has to live in the shell's static styles, and none exists there. The :host rule (138-149, 100vh, overflow hidden) and the overflow-y:auto content scroller clip the printout to one sheet. Cosmetic: the app has no print feature.

title: config-sidebar.ts duplicated display-options/dye-filters blocks
reason: The brief's REFACTOR bar is size that hides a correctness risk, and none is shown. The cited divergence is inert: handleDisplayOptionsChange's first parameter is the unused _tool (838), so Presets passing 'harmony' does nothing. The accessibility visibleGroups=['colorFormats'] is deliberate. Lit diffs of hidden sections over constant bindings are negligible.

title: preset-tool.ts reconcileTombstones/saved pool: saving a local-* palette duplicates it and tombstones it as 'Removed by its author'
reason: preset-card.ts:419-433 always renders Save (only the vote button is gated on isFromAPI). toggle() stores a local-x snapshot, so the saved case of currentTabPool (preset-tool.ts:744-760) returns it twice. reconcileTombstones (:635-641) skips only isCurated, so local-x is marked deleted and both cards get the tombstone chip.

title: preset-tool.ts loadPresets: no supersede guard; reconcileTombstones checks the current searchQuery, not the one fetched
reason: loadPresets (:586-618) has no sequence guard. handleSearchInput clears searchQuery at once, but the in-flight 'x' fetch then lands, sets this.presets and calls reconcileTombstones, whose guard (:631) reads the now-empty query. Every saved community preset outside the 'x' results gets markDeleted, which persists to localStorage; an out-of-order landing leaves the stale pool showing.

title: preset-tool.ts handleCardVote: every failed vote is shown as 'already voted'; a failed removeVote is silent
reason: voteForPreset never throws on failure: it returns success:false with errorCode voteFailed/network/notLoggedIn (community-preset-service.ts:394-441). handleCardVote's else branch (:859-863) marks the card voted and toasts alreadyVoted without checking already_voted. A failed removeVote has no else branch at all. preset-detail.ts:821-826 already branches correctly.

title: preset-detail.ts checkVoteStatus: a failed hasVoted check overwrites the vote count with 0
reason: hasVoted returns {has_voted:false, vote_count:0} on a non-OK or network failure (community-preset-service.ts:522-535). checkVoteStatus (preset-detail.ts:697-701) applies any vote_count that is not undefined, so currentVoteCount becomes 0. Graded LOW: display-only and transient, since failures are not cached.

title: preset-tool.ts handleVoteUpdate: votedIds is not synced from the detail view, so card and detail vote state diverge
reason: handleVoteUpdate (:915-921) replaces only the preset/voteCount and never touches votedIds (:113). The detail's vote-update event carries no voted flag. After voting in the list and un-voting in the detail, the card still shows Voted, and clicking it calls removeVote, whose failure is silent.

title: result-card.ts handleMenuClick/handleSelectClick: stopPropagation keeps other cards' open menus from closing
reason: handleMenuClick (:1125-1128) and handleSelectClick (:1094-1095) call stopPropagation. The click therefore never reaches the document listener (:1459-1466, registered at :1487) that closes the other cards' menus, so card A's menu stays open while card B's opens. No test covers click-away. Not among the dead-code catalog's ContextAction removals.

title: preset-tool.ts categoryCount/renderTabs: counts ignore feedBlend, feedHideUnbuyable, keepDeleted and the saved search, and the Saved badge omits local palettes
reason: categoryCount (:775-786) builds its own base: community is always presets.filter(!isCurated), with no feedBlend or feedHideUnbuyable; saved has no keepDeleted filter and no search on the snapshot half. The tab badges (:996-1014) use savedList.length (no local palettes) and the raw community count. currentTabPool (:739-772) applies all of these, so counts and the list disagree.

title: preset-tool.ts handleSearchInput/sort: refetches the API pool with a spinner on Saved/Mine tabs whose pools are local
reason: handleSearchInput (:998-1005) and a sortBy change (:395-398) always call loadPresets, which shows the grid spinner (renderGrid :1076) on every tab. The saved pool filters locally and is never sorted by sortBy, and mine ignores both search and sort. On those tabs the refetch is wasted and the Sort button changes nothing visible.

title: preset-tool.test.ts: no coverage of reconcileTombstones, vote handling, tab pools/counts or savedFirst
reason: preset-tool.test.ts (487 lines) has only 7 cases: 6 under BUG-005 popstate/deep-link (:240-461) and 1 under BUG-027 debounce teardown (:463). reconcileTombstones (preset-tool.ts:630), handleCardVote (:881), tab pools / categoryCount and savedFirst (:764-766) are never exercised. voteForPreset, removeVote and markDeleted are only bare vi.fn() mocks (:108-120), and savedFirst is only a config fixture value (:140, :203). preset-tool.ts is also on vitest.config.ts's coverage exclude list (:36, 'awaiting tests'), so no coverage ratchet catches the gap. The e2e specs preset-gallery-api.spec.ts and preset-browser.spec.ts never touch votes, the Saved tab or tombstones.

title: tutorial-spotlight.ts: window-only scroll listener and a fixed 100ms measurement leave the spotlight off-target after a container smooth-scroll
reason: The BUG-086 scroll listener sits on window, but the shell host is height:100vh with overflow:hidden, so tools scroll inside shadow containers (.v4-layout-content-scroll, .v4-tool-main) and window gets no scroll event. A smooth scrollIntoView (:534) is measured once after a fixed 100ms (:264-267), and ResizeObserver does not fire on scroll, so the spotlight and tooltip stay at the mid-scroll rect. The full-screen overlay (:195-202) mostly blocks user scrolling, so the smooth-scroll path is the real repro.

The test gap is real, but it belongs with -01's fix. The new repros cannot happen: start() runs only from a user click (welcome-modal.ts:129 / the prompt), so nothing restarts a tutorial within 300ms of hide(). The missing-target stale currentTarget lasts at most 100ms before next(), and nothing ever calls update() on the spotlight, so bindEvents cannot re-subscribe.

title: collection-manager-modal.ts: creating from the manager never refreshes the manager list, count or create-limit state
reason: The manager's New collection button calls showCreateCollectionDialog() with no callback (:69). On create, the dialog dismisses only itself (:328). The manager content is static DOM built once (:20-113) with no CollectionService subscription, so the list, the count and createBtn.disabled stay stale until the modal is reopened.

title: my-submissions-modal.ts: after a successful delete the modal keeps showing the deleted preset and stale stats
reason: The confirm button runs onConfirm() without awaiting it, then dismisses the confirm (modal-container.ts:347-350). On success the handler only calls onChanged, which reloads the preset-tool lists underneath (preset-tool.ts:1081-1084). The My Submissions rows, stat tiles and subtitle are innerHTML built once (:89-176), so the deleted row stays, and the later dismiss(confirmId) at :216 is a 'Modal not found' no-op.

EMPTY_STATE_PRESETS.noSearchResults has no production caller (git grep: only empty-state.test.ts; harmony-tool uses only noHarmonyResults). It is one of the 6 test-only preset factories that DEAD-008 removes.

title: modal-container.ts attachSheetDrag: ignores inner scrollers and touchcancel on mobile sheets
reason: touchstart engages the drag whenever the modal body's scrollTop is 0, without checking inner scrollers such as the collection list (max-h-96 overflow-y-auto, collection-manager-modal.ts:99). Dragging down to scroll that list up translates the sheet, and a pull past 90px dismisses it. There is no touchcancel handler, so a cancelled gesture leaves transform and transition:none set.

title: toast-container.ts: full rebuild on each change replays animations and re-announces alerts; Escape closes toast and modal together
reason: Every ToastService notify calls update(), and renderContent clears and rebuilds every toast (:169,193-203). Survivors get toast-animate-in again (0.3s slide) and fresh role=alert/aria-live nodes, so they re-animate and are re-announced. Escape is handled on document by both the toast (:71-77) and the modal (modal-container.ts:202-208), and neither stops the other.

title: preset-submission-form.ts: dismissTop() after awaited submit/upload can close the wrong modal; unguarded sessionStorage write inside the submit try
reason: dismissTop() at :725/:758 runs after await submitPreset (and after await uploadPreviewImage), while showPresetSubmissionForm drops the ModalService.show id (:104). If the user closes the closable form and opens another modal during the request, that other modal gets closed. Separately, sessionStorage.setItem (:730) inside the try turns a blocked-storage throw into submitPresetFailed after the duplicate toast. Both need user or browser conditions, hence LOW.

title: advanced-options-panel settings import restores analyticsEnabled; alert() on failure
reason: Import is an explicit user action that restores a full settings backup. exportAllConfigs writes advanced.analyticsEnabled, so a round-trip restoring the user's own toggle is the intended behaviour, not consent bypass, and GPC is still honoured (telemetry-service.ts:122). The alert() at :327 works and is localized, so it is a style choice, not a defect.

title: CollapsiblePanel collapsed content focusable / 1000px max-height clip
reason: This is unreachable in production. Every CollapsiblePanel is built in renderLeftPanel or renderDrawerContent. v4-layout.ts:600-706, the only mount path, passes leftPanel===rightPanel (renderRightPanel's clearContainer wipes the panels) and drawerContent: null, so no collapsed panel ever stays in the DOM to take focus or clip.

title: collection-manager-modal downloadSingleCollection filename strips all non-ASCII (CJK names become dashes)
reason: collection-manager-modal.ts:535 applies /[^a-z0-9]/gi, so a collection named in ja/ko/zh exports as xivdyetools-----.json, a meaningless name (import reads content, so there is no data loss). The Safari half (the input is removed synchronously at :606) is plausible but unverified here; it is not the basis of this verdict.

title: preset-submission-service.deletePreset failure reported as success by both callers
reason: deletePreset (preset-submission-service.ts:471-503) catches everything and returns {success:false}; preset-tool.ts:982-989 and my-submissions-modal.ts:213-216 await it, ignore the result, toast deleteSuccess and close/reload, so their catch branches are unreachable.

title: community-preset-service response cache never invalidated after delete/edit/submit
reason: SimpleCache (5 min TTL) keys presets:<query>/preset:<id>; no non-test code calls clearCache() (hybrid-preset-service.ts:460 wrapper has no caller), votes only delete preset:/vote: keys, so preset-tool's post-delete loadPresets() reuses the cached list.

title: CollectionService.initialize re-enters and overflows the stack when a migration save fails
reason: Reproduced with a temp test (deleted): stored collections at version 1.0.0 plus StorageService.setItem returning false makes getCollections() throw RangeError. initialized is set only after loadCollections, and save->notify->getCollections->initialize re-reads the unmigrated data each time.

title: hybrid getPresets hides a failed API leg, so preset-tool tombstones all saved community presets
reason: hybrid-preset-service.ts:293-317 logs and swallows a failed community fetch; apiAvailable is only set at init (:128), so preset-tool.ts:599-606 sees offline=false and apiCount 0<50 and calls reconcileTombstones, which marks every saved community preset deleted.

title: LanguageService.tInterpolate expands $ patterns in user-supplied values
reason: language-service.ts:188 passes String(value) as a replace() replacement string, so $$, $&, $` and $' are expanded (node check: 'Added to {name}' with 'Budget $$' gives 'Added to Budget $'); add-to-collection-menu.ts:105/:242 pass user collection names.

title: market-board-service superseded-request catch sets outcome 'error'
reason: Unreachable input: the awaited core getPricesForDataCenter does not reject on network/HTTP failure, because fetchBatchPriceData (APIService.ts:653-674) catches and returns an empty Map and cache reads/writes are caught too. So a superseded request never reaches the market-board-service.ts:398-410 catch.

title: keyboard-service digit tool shortcuts unreachable from the AZERTY number row
reason: keyboard-service.ts:184-186 requires !e.shiftKey and looks up TOOL_KEY_MAP[e.key]. On AZERTY the unshifted top row yields '&','é',... and digits need Shift, so the documented 1-9/0 shortcuts only work from a numpad.

title: LanguageService.setLocale has no sequencing; overlapping calls desync core and web locales
reason: setLocale (language-service.ts:83-129) sets core LocalizationService synchronously-ish first, then awaits a dynamic import of the locale chunk before committing currentLocale. Two overlapping calls with different targets on a cold chunk leave core on the later call and the web locale on the slower one; getDyeName proxies (:202) read core's current locale.

title: collection-service importData: BUG-024 guard dereferences a null collections[] element outside the per-record try
reason: Only a JSON null element throws: the guard at :938-941 reads collection.name before the per-record try (:950), so a TypeError reaches the outer catch at :1004 and pushes parseFailed with success:false. Earlier favorites and collections are already persisted, and the records after the null are abandoned. A number or string element reads .name as undefined and is skipped cleanly.

title: auth-service performLogout awaits /auth/revoke with no timeout before clearing local session
reason: The comment at :753 says the revoke is non-blocking, but :756 awaits the fetch with no AbortSignal. clearStorage/clearState/notify only run after it settles, so a stalled revoke leaves the token stored and the UI signed in. The BUG-025 memoised logoutPromise makes every retry share the hang. No test uses a never-resolving fetch.

title: indexeddb-service has no db.onversionchange handler, so an open tab blocks a future DB_VERSION upgrade and the other tab caches initialize()=false
reason: onsuccess (:85-89) never installs onversionchange. With a tab open on the old version, a DB_VERSION bump triggers onblocked (:122-125), which resolves false, and initPromise caches that result. get/set self-heal once the blocked open later succeeds, but IndexedDBCacheBackend (api-service-wrapper.ts:85-89, BUG-004 caches its own outcome) never runs loadFromStorage, so that tab's price cache is not hydrated. Latent: it only matters on a future DB_VERSION bump. Caching false after onerror is correct, because those failures are permanent.

title: services importing the @services/index barrel (circular) — decided convention, no concrete failure
reason: No failing state exists: every barrel reference is used at call time. The barrel is the repo's deliberate mock seam (eslint.config.js:74-106; harmony-generator.test.ts:14 and mixer-blending-engine.test.ts:14 mock @services/index), so 'import concrete modules' would make those mocks inert, which is the BUG-040/PR #161 trap. The keyboard-service→shortcuts-panel cycle is likewise only hypothetical.

title: IndexedDBCacheBackend.loadFromStorage hydrates the price cache with one serial readonly transaction per key
reason: The cited line 586 is wrong: the file has 266 lines, and the code is at :158-173. It runs keys() and then awaits one get() transaction per key in sequence, although IndexedDBService.getAll already exists. Graded as OPT only. The re-add after clear() is bounded to one in-flight get, that entry is memory-only (IndexedDB stays cleared) and holds public price data, so the FINDING-008 goal still holds. The stale-overwrite race is also bounded, because core's TTL check evicts expired entries on read.

title: main.ts:111 boot awaits getServicesStatus() network probe used only by a dev-only log, delaying the v4 shell
reason: main.ts:111 awaits getServicesStatus -> services/index.ts:126 getAPIStatus -> core APIService.ts:1031 GET {base}/data-centers with 5000 ms abort; result only feeds logger.info, which is gated by isDev() (shared/logger.ts:152); initializeV4Layout (main.ts:122) waits on it. CSP connect-src allows *.xivdyetools.app, so the request really goes out. Not in 2026-09-16 Rejected suspicions.

title: main.ts:126 non-critical tutorial-spotlight import failure triggers renderFatalError over the already-rendered shell
reason: tutorial-spotlight is imported only dynamically by main.ts (own 9 KB chunk per bundle report), inside the same try as critical init; a rejection reaches catch -> renderFatalError -> container.replaceChildren (fatal-error.ts:71) wiping the working v4 shell. Candidate's 'stale tab' repro is wrong (init runs once per load), but the first-load trigger is real. Not in 2026-09-16 Rejected suspicions.

Unreachable: v4-layout.ts:29,31 statically value-imports changelog-modal and welcome-modal (both in the 'modals' manualChunk, vite.config.ts), so by main.ts:133 the shell has already loaded and evaluated them; the dynamic imports resolve from the module map and cannot fail independently.

Decided, documented design (functions/README.md: 'Runs on every request'); the FINDING-027 /assets/* guard needs function routing anyway, and almost every served file is under /assets/ (public/ has only a handful of root files), so _routes.json would save next to nothing. The quota-outage claim is unverified (plan unknown).

'Cannot drift' (example-link.ts:6) refers to the two forms agreeing with each other; server char rule bans only control/invisible chars, so an interior space passes; a >300-char rejection reaches the user via result.error as toast details (preset-submission-form.ts:767-772, edit form likewise) — server is authoritative, nothing lost.

title: palette-export.ts:136 today() stamps exports with the UTC date, not the local date
reason: today() = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] feeds the header generatedLine (:169), JSON generated (:254) and filename (:317); evening users west of UTC get tomorrow's date. palette-export.test.ts pins no clock/timezone. Cosmetic.

Decided trade-off: the 2026-08-20 web-app i18n plan that introduced FATAL_STRINGS scoped it to title/body/button and ruled 'constants.ts ERROR_MESSAGES stays' (docs/audits/2026-08-20-web-app-i18n/EXECUTION_TASKS.md:195).

title: preset.ts processSubmit/EditCommand duplicates the presets-api webhook moderation and submission-log posts
reason: processSubmitCommand posts its own embeds: preset.ts:571 notifySubmissionChannel and :576 notifyModerationChannel, which uses legacy ids with no contentRevision (:1142-1150). presets-api POST /presets also calls notifyDiscordBot for every caller, bot included (presets.ts:1077-1091, source: auth.authSource), and the webhook then posts a second embed (index.ts:402-404 if pending, :446-456 if approved). Edits are doubled only when the edit changes text or is flagged (presets.ts:841-846). For a non-text edit to an already-pending preset, the bot's legacy embed is the only post.

title: Webhook-path edit notifications are posted as kind 'new': no diff, no Revert button
reason: The webhook always builds kind 'new' (index.ts:407), and the payload carries no edit marker (types/preset.ts:48-73), so a presets-api edit notification (presets.ts:847-867) is titled 'New Preset Pending' with no diff and no Revert (preset-notifications.ts:214). The claim overreaches in one place: bot-path edits still get a two-click Revert, because review-message.ts:146-149 offers it on refresh. Web edits get no Revert at all, and Reject on that embed rejects the whole previously approved preset.

title: budget.ts/preferences.ts: validateWorld cold-cache service calls are awaited inside the 3 s ack window
reason: Four handlers await validateWorld before answering Discord: budget.ts:215 (find) and :504 (quick) before deferredResponse, plus budget.ts:450 (set_world) and preferences.ts:342, both fully synchronous with no defer. On a cold isolate validateWorld (universalis-client.ts:356-372) makes up to 2 sequential service-binding fetches with a 10 s timeout each (:79, :115). This is the same defect as BUG-008, which was rated MEDIUM. Exposure is narrowed by api-worker's per-colo Cache API (24 h TTL + 6 h SWR): it takes a full cache miss plus a slow Universalis.

title: preview-image.ts puts a raw <@id> mention in the embed footer and drops the preset ID
reason: preview-image.ts:261 builds `<@id>` and :277-291 puts it into the embed footer, where Discord does not resolve mentions. The same edit replaces the original footer `ID: <presetId>` set at index.ts:354, so the resolved message loses the preset id.

title: stats.ts overview: Avg Cmds/User divides a lifetime total by today's users
reason: stats.ts:239-240 divides stats.totalCommands by uniqueUsersToday. totalCommands is the stats:total counter, whose 30-day TTL is renewed on every put (analytics.ts:181-184), so it is effectively a lifetime count. uniqueUsersToday covers today's usertrack keys only (:316-324). The ratio is therefore meaningless. The panel is admin-only.

title: stats.ts summary pages all of today's user keys it never displays
reason: The public summary at stats.ts:174 calls getStats, which always pages the usertrack:<today>: keys (analytics.ts:316-324), yet the summary reads only totalCommands and successRate. Below 1,000 DAU the waste is one KV list op per call, more pages above that. The call runs pre-ack and the command is rate-limited.

title: preset.ts favorite list fans out one getPreset per favourite (up to 50)
reason: preset.ts:1380-1382 makes one presets-api getPreset call per favourite, up to MAX_PRESET_FAVORITES = 50 (preset-favorites.ts:34), via Promise.all. That is up to 50 service-binding subrequests and 50 D1 reads per list. The work runs after the deferred ack (:1358), and getPreset sends no user id, so presets-api's per-user limiter never fires. Pure I/O cost, no correctness impact.

title: preset.ts typed dye names resolved before the locale loads: not a defect
reason: The locale is already loaded. createUserTranslator (bot-i18n.ts:36-41, the F-02 warm-up) and createUserTranslatorWithPrefs (:63/:67) await initializeLocale for the same locale that t.getLocale() returns, before any searchDyesByName or resolveColorInput call. The only createTranslator branches without it (accessibility.ts:51, gradient.ts:46, contrast.ts:44) run when there is no userId, which the dispatcher rejects, so they are unreachable. Same code at 8ecb878f.

title: gradient.ts processGradientCommand: Start/End lines print the English Dye.name while step rows are localized
reason: In gradient.ts:185-190 the Start/End text uses startColor.name / endColor.name. Those come from bot-logic resolveColorInput (input-resolution.ts:242-252), which always returns the English dye.name, even when a locale name matched. The step rows use dyeName, which bot-logic gradient.ts:290 localizes with getLocalizedDyeName.

title: extractor.ts renderColorSheet: render/edit failure is never logged and is reported to the user as 'no match found'
reason: handleColorSubcommand (extractor.ts:190) passes no logger, and renderColorSheet has no logger parameter. Its catch (extractor.ts:385-389) only calls markCommandOutcome('render'), which records an outcome class and no exception. It then answers errors.noMatchFound, although a match already exists at that point (matches.length > 0 was checked before deferring).

title: preset-api X-User-Discord-Name non-Latin1 header throw (not on workerd)
reason: Misread runtime: workerd does not apply the WebIDL ByteString TypeError to header values. Probed on workerd 1.20260923 via miniflare with compat date 2024-12-01: new Request() with X-User-Discord-Name '桜の夢' and 'Zoë' succeeds, and a service-binding callee reads the exact same string back. Production reaches presets-api through the PRESETS_API [[env.production.services]] binding in both discord-worker and moderation-worker, so neither site throws. The reviewer saw the throw only because vitest runs with environment 'node', which uses undici's ByteString check.

title: command-trace isUserCondition counts the Universalis client's synthetic 408 timeout as an answered 'rejected' outcome
reason: isUserCondition (command-trace.ts:310-312) accepts any 4xx except 429. universalis-client.ts:170-172 turns the abort from its own 10 s timer into UniversalisError(408), and workerd's abort rejection is an Error named AbortError (probed). fetchWithCache rethrows that error when no stale entry exists, budget.ts:409 classifies it as 'rejected', and ANSWERED_OUTCOMES (line 71) records the timeout as success.

title: preferences getUserPreferences swallows read failure as {} and the set/reset writes then overwrite or delete the user's whole prefs blob
reason: The swallow is at preferences.ts:138-142 (claim cited 126): a kv.get rejection or a JSON.parse failure returns {}. setPreferences (281-291) applies the new key to that {} and puts it, replacing the whole blob. resetPreference(key) (333-347) then sees hasPrefs false and kv.delete()s the blob. Both report success. This is a failed read treated as empty, not the BUG-036 concurrency race.

title: preset-favorites getPresetFavoriteEntries returns [] on read failure and addPresetFavorite overwrites the user's list
reason: Same mechanism as 03, so it gets the same grade. Line corrected: the file is 193 lines, so 620 does not exist. The catch at preset-favorites.ts:95-100 returns [] on a kv.get or parse failure. addPresetFavorite (147-150) pushes onto that [] and savePresetFavoriteEntries writes both the v2 and v1 keys, replacing a list of up to 50 with one entry and reporting success.

title: preferences validate/apply case mismatch (latent, unreachable)
reason: Unreachable input. Every boolean pref option is OptionType.BOOLEAN and count is OptionType.INTEGER (schemas.ts:665-720), so Discord delivers booleans and numbers. The only other setPreference caller passes 'world' (budget.ts:463). No production path supplies 'ON' or a numeric string.

title: preferences legacy-key migration re-reads two dead KV keys on every call for users with no prefs blob
reason: With no prefs:v1 blob, getUserPreferences calls migrateLegacyPreferences on every call (preferences.ts:136-137), and that does 2 legacy kv.get reads (533-544) that are never negative-cached. resolveUserLocale (bot-logic locale-resolution.ts:147-163) adds an unified read plus a legacy read, so a user without a blob pays about 5 reads where 2 would do. The legacy writers were removed in March 2026 (per the docblock at 520-524). This is not one of the declined caches: those OPT-005/009 are core colour items from 2026-09-02.

title: budget price-cache does not negative-cache unlisted ids (negligible; proxy already caches)
reason: The cited line does not exist: price-cache.ts is 260 lines. The un-cached ids cost only a service-binding hop, because the proxy has its own 5-minute 'aggregated' cache (api-worker config/cache.ts:20-24, keyed on the normalised id set), so Universalis is hit at most once per id set per TTL. Region-wide unlisted dyes were not shown to occur, so there is no demonstrated gain.

title: universalis-client abort timer cleared before body read (unreachable via buffered proxy)
reason: No 'headers then stalled body' state exists on the production path. The proxy at the other end of UNIVERSALIS_PROXY fully buffers the upstream with AbortSignal.timeout (cached-fetch.ts:148) and replies with c.json(result.data), a complete string body (router.ts:263). Headers and body therefore arrive together. Only the local-dev URL fallback could stream a stalled body.

preset.ts:571/576/924 post the submission-log or moderation embed from the bot side. presets-api presets.ts:1077-1091 (submit) and :845-870 (edit) also call notifyDiscordBot with no authSource filter (it is gated only on the DISCORD_WORKER binding and the secret), and index.ts:402 (pending) and :446 (approved) post a second copy. The webhook is live in production because web submissions depend on it.

Setting the flag before the send is a documented decision (index.ts:808, 'Flag before sending — a failed send must never become a repeat notice'). Three KV round-trips run before sendFollowUp, so a pre-callback 404 is a timing tail, not a reproducible failure. The deferred-slot and ephemeral-flip outcome rests on Discord follow-up-after-defer semantics that nothing in the repo shows, so it cannot be made to fail on this code.

getPreset (preset-api.ts:237-246) returns null only on a 404 and rethrows 5xx, timeout and 429. index.ts:1291-1295 swallows the error with .catch(()=>null) and sets name = id, and :1306 persists it. Because the back-fill selects entries by !e.name, the UUID name is never retried, so wrong data stays in KV durably. The rename and concurrent-add points are the OPT-007 design and the known KV read-modify-write limitation, so they are not graded.

index.test.ts autocomplete cases (:1890-2340) cover dye, preset approved/show/edit and the preset dye option only. No test reaches the subcommand-group walk (/preset favorite remove), getFavoritedPresetsAutocompleteChoices including the BUG-028 guard, clan, or the /preferences world branch. The only favourites test is the service-level preset-favorites.test.ts.

index.ts:404 hard-codes kind 'new'. presets-api sends the same type:'submission' payload for edits (presets.ts:845-866), and rowToPreset carries previous_values. A flagged web edit therefore posts 'New preset pending' with no diff and no Revert, while a refresh adds Revert back (moderation-worker review-message.ts:146-149). The origin is MAIN, not PR-#227: main already rendered kind 'new'.

The sync-dye-emojis.yml header documents that embeds reference deleted ids until the new mapping is committed and deployed, and the bundled mapping changes nothing until that deploy. A mid-run failure therefore leaves no worse than the documented state. The failure is loud (the job fails), and a rerun is idempotent because the artwork tag stays old and the whole set is regenerated.

index.ts:1137 passes only { status: 'approved' }. searchPresetsForAutocomplete logs in its catch only when options.logger is set (preset-api.ts:516-522), so a presets-api failure on the show/vote/favorite-add autocomplete returns [] with no log line, while the edit and favourites paths do log.

title: preset-moderation.ts processApproval / preset-rejection.ts processRejection: success embed spreads a prior 'Error' field
reason: Failure paths (preset-moderation.ts:252-271, ban guard :187-202; preset-rejection.ts:195-214) append an 'Error' field and pass no `components`, so the buttons stay live. The success edit at :216-219 (and preset-rejection.ts:157-161, not :521) spreads `originalEmbed.fields`, so the Error field survives under 'Preset Approved'.

title: review-message.ts refreshReview: a losing concurrent click's 409 refresh overwrites the winner's 'Approved by'/'Reason' embed
reason: presets-api moderation.ts:234-236 answers STALE_REVIEW when the conditional UPDATE matches 0 rows. preset-moderation.ts:242-244 then calls refreshReview, whose :188-200 replaces the whole embed via buildReviewEmbed with a 'nothing left to review' notice and components []. The win's attribution field is dropped, and this edit lands after an extra GET round trip, so usually last.

title: bot-i18n.ts footerTextOnly advertises the removed `reject <id> <reason>` option; preset.test.ts:446 pins it
reason: register-commands.ts:56-79 now defines only `action` and `preset_id` (main had `reason` at :80), yet preset.ts:213-215 still renders 'reject <id> <reason>' on every text-only pending list.
